title: 26 January 1964: Live: Olympia Theatre, Paris
content:
Two more shows at the Olympia Theatre, on Paris’s Boulevard des Capucines.

The Beatles’ residency at the Olympia Theatre began on 16 January 1964 and ended on 4 February. They performed a set containing eight songs: ‘From Me To You’, ‘Roll Over Beethoven’, ‘She Loves You’, ‘This Boy’, ‘Boys’, ‘I Want To Hold Your Hand’, ‘Twist And Shout’ and ‘Long Tall Sally’.

Page last updated: 24 January 2024
